title: OurEventRing HIPAA Pool Schema
description: BigQuery table schema for the HIPAA regulatory pool. Separate encryption keys, BAA-controlled access, mandatory full audit logging. Same table structure as General with additional compliance fields.
declined_by: OCR_STANDARD_declinedRegimes.md (ratified 2026-09-04). Hospital/PHI data is off the books — a declined regime, not a tier OCR matures into. This schema is retained as a record of what is refused, NOT a roadmap commitment. No OCR product routes writes to oureventring_hipaa; OSE phaseToPool() refuses legal_clearance_tier 4 (OSE-1220).

events.description: Core event records for HIPAA-regulated events. Inherits General structure with additional compliance fields.

additional_fields.name: phi_classification
additional_fields.description: Level of PHI proximity (none, adjacent, direct).

additional_fields.name: access_log_id
additional_fields.description: Links to mandatory access audit log.

additional_fields.name: consent_reference
additional_fields.description: Reference to participant consent record, if applicable.

qr_scans.description: QR scan events in HIPAA context. Same anonymous session pattern but with audit trail.

access_audit_log.description: HIPAA-mandated audit log. Every read and write to this pool is logged.

fields.name: justification
fields.description: Reason for access, if required by policy.

de_identification_pipeline.description: HIPAA Safe Harbor method. Strip all 18 identifiers before data flows to aggregate intelligence layer.
